notes: Build84 clean runtime starts from stable Build82. Shipped surface is allowlisted to the canonical launcher, event-driven runtime client, clean account controller, minimal UX polish layer and minimal runtime bus only. License activation, protocol-based Trust, GitHub, Supabase and on-demand project state are reattached without the legacy DOM stack. Reattached modules render functional surfaces inside the single launcher Shadow DOM. OAuth is only initiated by an explicit Connect click. Supabase project discovery combines direct /projects with organization-scoped project listing. UX polish removes internal implementation footnotes from module surfaces and makes an active rail item toggle its open flyout/detail closed without observers or polling. No legacy ui/content stack, mount guardian, global MutationObserver, continuous polling, heavy provider engine, OTA metadata or release publication is shipped.
